rail.initial_source:
physical_controller 1
force_n = -mass_kg * velocity_mps / dt_s if clearance_m <= 0.25 else 0
rail.corrected_source:
physical_controller 1
force_n = -mass_kg * velocity_mps / dt_s if clearance_m <= stopping_distance_m + margin_m or speed_mps < 0.03 else 0

differential_rover.corrected_source:
physical_controller 1
left_nm = axis_left * radius_m * (gravity_force_n + position_gain * (target_m - progress_m) - speed_gain * forward_speed_mps) / 2
right_nm = axis_right * radius_m * (gravity_force_n + position_gain * (target_m - progress_m) - speed_gain * forward_speed_mps) / 2
